question: Tamladu is the religious festival of the Digaru Mishmis tribe of which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arunachal Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Tamladu** is a significant religious festival celebrated by the **Digaru Mishmi tribe**.
 
• The festival takes place in the northeastern state of **Arunachal Pradesh**, India.
 
• Tamladu is observed on **15th February** every year.
 
• It involves rituals and prayers to the **forest and river gods** for protection and prosperity.
 
• The festival is also a time for the community to come together and celebrate their cultural heritage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arunachal Pradesh**:

 
 
• It is located in the northeastern part of India.
 
• The state capital is **Itanagar**.
 
• Arunachal Pradesh is known for its diverse tribal cultures and traditions.
 
• The state shares international borders with Bhutan, China, and Myanmar.
 
 
 
• **Digaru Mishmi Tribe**:
 
 
• They are one of the indigenous tribes of Arunachal Pradesh.
 
• The tribe is known for its rich cultural heritage and traditional practices.
 
• They primarily reside in the Lohit district of Arunachal Pradesh.
 
 
 
• **Traditional Festivals of Arunachal Pradesh**:
 
 
• Other notable festivals include Losar, Mopin, and Solung.
 
• These festivals showcase the state's cultural diversity and traditional customs.
 
 
 
• **Geographical Significance**:
 
 
• Arunachal Pradesh is known for its scenic beauty, with lush valleys, rivers, and mountains.
 
• The state is home to several national parks and wildlife sanctuaries.
